statement: Evaluation risk: no retrieved work reports an explicit held-out-hop transfer protocol (train on shallow hops, test on deeper hops) as a headline result, so the idea's central transfer claim has no directly comparable baseline; reported multi-hop results are per-benchmark (MetaQA is stratified by hop count, WebQSP/CWQ are up to 2/4-hop), and several abstracts do not even name their benchmark suites.
